notes.title: PC VR Full Version Release
notes.notes:
The full version of Z-Race will be released on December 10th on PC VR via Steam! We’re excited to bring 15 tracks, 13 racing ships, and two game modes to the full version of the game. The game modes will be an asynchronous most multiply career mode and a cross-platform tournament mode. Be ready for an action-packed experience, where the battle for the top spot never ends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670151/a4106966da0a96c73c23a8e5540f8b10ffe1615e.png[/img]

We take you on a journey across the Z-Race universe! With 15 tracks of varying difficulty and creative lore, prepare to be immersed in a high-tech futuristic universe. Compete by flying 13 Formula Z bolides across three-speed classes, each equipped with your companion coach, voiced by your favorite members of the VR community. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670151/be3d49ad15d3da7552ecd5bc2912cdff8a7f0f6e.png[/img]

Experience high speed without motion sickness!

notes.title: Z-Race Competition
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670151/3180c5d4d087582acacebe0e86ac1e2aa1dd28dc.png[/img]

The first ever Z-RACE in-game event will take place this Friday, June 4th. The in-game competition will see players compete over a 10-day period for the top 10 positions in the global leaderboards of a brand new track within the Silver City location: Champion's Track. 

At 11:59pm PST, all leaderboard positions will be locked in, and the winners will be finalized. The grand prize will be $100, with second place getting $75, third place getting $50, and 4th through 10th places each getting $25. All prizes are in the form of Steam gift cards. Each racer can claim only one prize, but can attempt to top the leaderboards as many times as they want between the start and end of the event.

Be sure to hop in game this Friday to compete in the Silver City Circuit for a chance to win one of these great prizes!

notes.title: Cockpit View
notes.notes:
We've had a lot of suggestions come through on various platforms (mainly our Discord which you can join with this [url=https://discord.com/invite/fdxBJ9KWne]link[/url] (if you haven't already) and we found one common theme throughout: people want a damn cockpit view. Well, here's your bombshell! We plan on supporting our hardcore community by working on a cockpit mode that would be exclusive to SteamVR. A lot of people are wondering how cockpit view will work with the current controls and track design. We've observed the same conflicts and found that the solution would be to implement alternative controls and tracks for this mode. We will keep you posted as this mode is developed. In the meantime, keep killing it on the leaderboards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670151/e4c9c443015864918dad8123123a6f16163c2df0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670151/8334261db9f0d077d715697b264655da2bd86779.jpg[/img]

Z-RACE is an arcade-style racer, and our unique control scheme has allowed anyone to experience a fast-paced racing game with minimal motion sickness.

notes.title: Z-Race Available now on Steam
notes.notes:
Z-RACE is packed with plenty of early access content to keep you hooked for hours! You can race on three different tracks for each of our four terrains, giving you 12 unique races in total. Each race you unlock on a given terrain will be more difficult than the last, so stay focused!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670151/842b12439f866b708f89bbd25fec88097d6db46d.png[/img]

In Z-RACE, your opponents are real and asynchronous. You’ll be matched with other racers based on your success in previous races. That way, you’ll always feel like you’re competing against fair opponents. New to the game? Expect the easiest opponents!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670151/28bd3f2ce424453a9600323f003d16e9ea036db1.png[/img]

You can also race with any of our 10 anti-grav racers, split into three unique speed classes. Unlock all the upgrades for all ships in a given speed class to unlock all the ships in the next speed class!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670151/1066d1d533bb71c51b060eecf3e8a17e2ef3c404.png[/img]
